scope: Actual saved arrays, manifests and existing verification records; no new propagation experiment.

conventions.width: probability RMS width divided by a
conventions.gaussian: psi0 proportional to exp[-(nx^2+ny^2)/(4 sigma^2)] exp[i q0 dot n]
conventions.default_boundary: N=256 periodic FFT; validity limited to tested interval before boundary return
conventions.eta_warning: A03 uses eta=0.35; B and C anisotropy cases use eta=0.3.

local_flip.status: Exact on infinite square lattice for specified one-flip initial state and cosine dispersion. Numerical periodic results match in validated window.

narrowband_group_velocity.status: Center-wavevector group velocity; finite-bandwidth packet mean speed differs.

gaussian_moments.status: The spectral-moment relation is exact on infinite lattice; continuous-Gaussian explicit velocity below is an approximation to sampled lattice envelope, extremely accurate for the supplied sigma>=2.
gaussian_moments.variance: Var(n_mu(tau))=Var(n_mu(0))+tau^2 Var(v_mu) for the unchirped real Gaussian envelope used here
gaussian_moments.continuous_gaussian_mean_velocity: <vx> ~= exp[-1/(8 sigma^2)] sin(q0x); <vy> ~= eta exp[-1/(8 sigma^2)] sin(q0y)

long_wave_tolerance.status: 1D axial energy relative overestimate only, not propagation fidelity.

return_probability.recommended_scale: Logarithmic y; values below lower display bound should not be rewritten as zero.

retain_as_images.reason: 2D density/colorbar, interference texture, contour/arrow field, or 3D surface. Use original scientific render or separately cropped panels with all scales retained.

verification.interpretation: These certify model implementation, conserved norm, analytic agreement and bounded box error within tested cases. They do not establish experimental realism, nonlinear dynamics or infinite-time exact shape preservation.

boundaries: Spatial exchange anisotropy Jx != Jy is not spin-space easy-axis/easy-plane anisotropy.
Normalized S=1/2 one-magnon amplitudes describe probability; do not depict a single-magnon state as finite transverse classical magnetization.
Spin quantization convention in figures is +x: <Sx_mn>=1/2-P_mn and <Sy>=<Sz>=0.
Square-lattice isotropic exchange preserves fourfold symmetry, not exact continuous rotational symmetry.
FFT is periodic; the saved interval is validated before relevant boundary return.
Main ballistic front based on maximum group velocity has nonzero tails outside; do not claim compact support or a hard causal cone.
Gaussian mean velocity is full spectral average; center group velocity is a narrowband approximation.
All plotted widths are RMS of probability, not amplitude width or FWHM.
The unchirped-envelope exact variance relation needs an initial position-velocity covariance term for general chirped states.
Frequency power conservation does not imply preserved real-space shape: relative spectral phases evolve.
Fidelity compares complex wavefunctions after translation by each packet spectral mean velocity; not just intensity overlap.
C13 sigma=3 has finite-duration improved shape preservation; C14 sigma=2 illustrates high-order deformation and is not an equal-width comparison.
A09 energy approximation error thresholds do not bound time-dependent phase error or fidelity.
